q1_issues.issue: (Inheritance mideast_peace_plan mideast) exposes a proper-noun place as a modifier genus; a noun modifier is never exposed and 'the plan is Mideast' is not predicable of it.
'Mideast peace plan' is fused as a compound kind even though 'Mideast' is a capitalized proper noun, which the compound-concepts rules explicitly exclude.
'overnight' is rendered as the day-part symbol night, a lexical normalization the instruction set defers downstream; the same substitution repeats at statement 27.
(LocatedIn sk_outpost_1 west_bank) infers containment from the attributive name modifier in 'West Bank settlement outposts'; no locative PP in the text states it.

q2_gaps: a proper noun used as an ATTRIBUTIVE modifier of a common-noun compound ('West Bank settlement outposts', 'Mideast peace plan') — Names & casing covers only a capitalized modifier joining the name and a lowercase adjective carving out a sub-region

an episodic (non-generic) bare plural subject/object ('ISRAELI soldiers knocked down empty mobile homes ... overnight') — the plural rules route a bare plural to the generic kind and reserve group witnesses for definite/demonstrative/possessed plurals
'overnight' as a temporal adjunct — the day-part inventory is morning/afternoon/evening/night only
notes: AsPartOf is read as licensed under the multi-word preposition-named oblique convention (AcrossTheLaneFrom). Splitting the coordinated object into two knock_down events, the empty/tiny per-member distribution rules, the israeli_soldier and water_tower decompositions, and the US-backed reduced relative all follow the instruction set.
